findings.title: Replaces the program that counts votes
findings.explanation: This replaces the code of the program that counts votes (Marinade Voter Stake Registry (VSR), Vote…tJsS — the realm's community voter-weight plugin). Whoever writes that code decides voting power: new code could give any wallet unlimited votes on every future proposal, including ones that drain the treasury.

findings.title: Dangerous actions execute instantly (hold-up time 0)
findings.explanation: Instruction #1 can be executed the moment voting ends — hold-up time is 0, so nobody has time to react (withdraw funds, alert the council) if the vote is won by an attacker. This governance's minimum hold-up time is 0 (executes immediately).

findings.title: The description does not match what the proposal does
findings.explanation: Description says: 'Routine security hardening and maintenance upgrade of the voter-stake-registry program. No parameter changes'. Actually: replaces the code of the voting program (Marinade Voter Stake Registry) that decides everyone's voting power.

findings.title: Upgrades program Marinade Voter Stake Registry (VSR)
findings.explanation: The new code (buffer FoNx…4kAv, 685,696 bytes) is not verified by this UI — compare its hash with a verified, reviewed build before voting. The buffer's rent goes to EwH7…TPQA, which is not a DAO account.
